summary: Planet Zoo entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Planet Zoo
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC release with DLC/Workshop/zoo state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with exact DLC, Workshop, and zoo/franchise state documented

primary.version: Current PC release with DLC/Workshop state documented
primary.why: The PC release is the fidelity route for complex zoo builds, DLC animals/scenery, Steam Workshop blueprints, and best capture flexibility. Console Edition is a valid later route but changes UI/control and content availability.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release. Record build, DLC ownership, Workshop blueprints, zoo/franchise/challenge/sandbox mode, animal roster, mods, graphics settings, and whether Console Edition was compared.

secondary.why: PC is the best Workshop/build/capture route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original management-sim route with Workshop and DLC.

all_releases.platform: PlayStation 5 / Xbox Series X|S Console Edition
all_releases.fidelity: Console adaptation with platform-specific UI/content cadence.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: DLC, Workshop assets, and franchise/server state determine the actual archive scope.

entries.remaster_caveats: Planet Zoo is related to Planet Coaster but is a separate franchise entry.
